content_blocks.label: clause_1._REASON_FOR_EVICTION
content_blocks.text: Tenant has failed to pay rent for the month of September 2024, as required under the lease agreement.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_TIME_TO_REMEDY
content_blocks.text: Tenant has thirty (30) days from the date of this notice to remedy the default and restore the premises to good repair.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._EFFECTIVE_DATE
content_blocks.text: If Tenant fails to remedy the default within the specified time, this notice shall become effective on the thirtieth day.
